capabilities.operation: Evaluate every canonical and effective Prompt Kit prompt for complete, actionable, non-lazy language and emit one disposition per prompt.
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Exhaustive static registry and effective-prompt language proof; no provider compliance proof.

capabilities.operation: Install executable correctness, routing, regression, performance, cost, and token-efficiency evals for a target skill and repair valid weaknesses.
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Depends on the eval lanes actually executed; static, model, runtime, and production proof must remain distinct.

capabilities.operation: Factor skill ownership into deterministic reusable boundaries without moving application behavior into prose.
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Static ownership and routing proof until model or runtime evals are executed.

capabilities.operation: Route Prompt Kit access by user intent and device: public browser use, phone install, Windows local app, editable checkout, or ZIP snapshot; require Git only when source work actually needs it.
inputs: public Prompt Kit and phone-launcher URLs
Git only when an editable checkout is required
Termux from F-Droid for an Android editable checkout
Windows PowerShell and Python only for the Windows local-app path
outputs: public Prompt Kit or phone install surface
validated Windows local app when requested
clean editable checkout when source work is requested
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Static routing, canonical URL/command, and preservation-first contract proof until the selected phone, browser, Termux, Windows launcher, network, or Git-authentication path is observed.

capabilities.operation: Inspect, repair, validate, report, and hand off the repository operational harness; when product code is out of scope, convert observed behavior gaps into enforceable focused contracts with non-strict harness evidence and explicit strict product gates.
inputs: focused domain contracts including harness/contracts/prompt-kit-order-navigation.v1.json and harness/contracts/pr-merge-gate.v1.json
existing harness failures, product-gap evidence, PR state, merge intent, and merge authority
outputs: focused product-gap audit when implementation is outside owned scope
commit and push or PR evidence
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Static repository, contract, source-gap, and CI harness proof on the tested commit; actual provider merges, product runtime, browser/mobile ergonomics, GUI, protected-target, and production proof remain separate.

capabilities.operation: Preview, classify, retain receipts for, and explicitly remove only eligible detached Prompt Kit browser-proof scratch directories under the OS temp root.
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Filesystem classification and cleanup receipt only; browser profile/localStorage/Favorites state remains separate.

capabilities.operation: Classify Prompt Kit header/search collisions, enforce responsive source and generated-artifact contracts, and require browser geometry before strict no-overlap proof.
outputs: browser geometry receipt for strict proof when available
capabilities.proof_ceiling: Static harness/source/artifact proof unless a validated browser-geometry receipt covers every declared viewport.

capabilities.operation: Classify and deduplicate one accepted Prompt Kit feedback signal, create a P115-owned bounded work request, and invoke at most one configured capable worker without polling or promotion authority.
inputs: accepted explicit feedback signal or sanitized provider receipt
current Prompt Kit feedback owner evidence
outputs: deduplicated prompt-kit-afk-work-request/v1 artifact for actionable feedback
bounded worker result or exact worker-configuration blocker
capabilities.proof_ceiling: One-shot repository routing and local work-request proof only; browser loopback behavior, worker quality, provider review, and promotion remain separate.
